notes.title: Patch 1 is Live!
notes.content:
[h1]Diesel Legacy Patch 1[/h1]

[h2]UI / Visuals:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added “Reduce Flash Effects” option for photosensitive players, which disables rapid screen flashes during Meltdowns.
[*] Fixed typos and inconsistencies in Training Mode text, and improved some hint text.
[*] Fixed bugs and typos in Fritz’s Story Mode.
[*] On-fire hitstun flame effects no longer appears when the character is invisible.
[*] Now auto-hides the mouse cursor after a period of inactivity.
[/list]

[h2]General Gameplay:
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Standing/crouching C attacks now break super armor as jumping C attacks already did.
[*] [i]Reduce setplay by allowing Safe Falls from attacks that are easy to combo into, use few/no resources, and are very advantageous afterward:[/i] Rory's Riser Height->Open, Nyra's Rising Gada final hit, Saga's Board Stretcher, and Dieselmech's Toot Sweet D attacks and Gravel Crusher now allow the opponent to Safe Fall.
[/list]

[h2]Adrik:[/h2]
[i]Adrik received a number of balance adjustments to improve his zoning and help his combos be more consistent, though he still has no low attacks or overheads.
[/i][list]
[*] [i][bugfix][/i] He can no longer perform buffered attacks out of dashes before the round starts. (Thanks Argenrost!)
[*] [i][bugfix][/i] Thorn Lance is properly disabled between rounds in 1v1.
[*] Reduced block damage on Charlier and Dovetail to match Bridge.
[*] Increased the opponent's movement from Bridge and Dovetail, both inward and outward.
[*] Charlier: added magic outline on cards for visibility; longer window for followup inputs; hitbox size increased to make contact with everyone standing; trajectory of hitbox is always consistent instead of following the random distribution of the visuals.
[*] Crouching D: Startup reduced by 2f to properly combo off B attacks; increased hitstun by 4f; can now hit downed opponents; increased the range of the Down-Forward version.
[*] [i][bugfix][/i] Ground special move motions ending in an Up direction (“tiger knee” inputs) will now produce the air special move rather than interrupting jump startup and performing the ground version.
[*] Thorn Lance rose startup reduced by 4f, now is 3f after the input; rose hitbox bigger.
[*] Thorn Orbit startup faster; recovery shorter; rose duration slightly shorter; properly becomes grounded if the air version lands.
[*] Thorn Volley startup faster; properly becomes grounded if the air version lands.
[*] Handbill hit now breaks super armor; increased the trigger area size and hitbox size, to make contact against the entire cast crouching.
[*] [i][bugfix][/i] Adrik is no longer prevented from placing a Handbill/Convincer while another object is attacking.
[*] [i][bugfix][/i] After placing a Handbill/Convincer, Adrik is now correctly in recovery instead of startup, allowing supercancels if the object he placed makes contact with an opponent.
[*] Convincer placement startup 15f faster; Convincer itself closes 6f faster once triggered and ejects the opponent at a slightly higher angle.
[*] Infernal Pact hitstun increased to allow conversions from farther away.
[/list]

[h2]Damkina:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [i][bugfix][/i] Fix sound effect bug when Damkina is KO’d during Don’t Ever Marry.
[/list]

[h2]Dieselmech:[/h2]
[i]Dieselmech received a number of small balance adjustments to help focus him as a high damage character with big attacks rather than also having excellent setplay, grabs, and runaway.[/i]

[list]
[*] World War Wonderful: to curb his ability to stall matches, the tank’s backward speed has been reduced by ~40%; backward recoil from charged shots reduced; all other speeds remain the same.
[*] [bugfix] Crouching A now hits all crouching opponents.
[*] Standing A is now an intentional antiair: it no longer hits crouching opponents except at very close range.
[*] Crouching B hitbox slightly lower to reduce its usefulness against bigger opponents trying to jump away.
[*] Crouching C range reduced from “ridiculous” to merely “very large”.
[*] Added a taller hitbox near his body during crouching D, to help with corner juggles.
[*] [bugfix] Cannot shoot a throw victim without having ammo loaded; without ammo, the input will now load ammo even with a throw victim.
[*] Reduced throw range by about ~10%.
[*] Opponent mashing to escape his throw is more effective, still possible to do a j.[C]->j.D.
[*] Can no longer perform supers while throwing an opponent: to fire a throw victim with a Big Bertha he must now load the shell before grabbing, which changes his gameplan to be less reactive.
[/list]

[h2]Eleanora:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Standing C dart hitbox adjusted, now hits all standing characters no matter how close they are.
[*] [bugfix] Normalized her height at the beginning of her crouch animation to be no shorter than the rest of it.
[/list]

[h2]Rory:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [bugfix] Cold Crack now accepts diagonal Down-Forward or Up-Forward to change lanes instead of requiring straight Up or Down.
[*] [bugfix] Thermal Fatigue now accepts holding any Up or Down direction to change lanes instead of requiring straight Up or Down.
[/list]

[h2]Rotwang:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Schultergerat hitstun and blockstun increased by 2f; ground version on hit is now +1 instead of -1.
[/list]

[h2]Saga[/h2]
[list]
[*] [bugfix] Key to the Midway correctly only adds 1 hit when grabbing someone out of hitstun.
[*] [bugfix] Board Stretcher’s grab can no longer be accidentally nullified by super-cancelling it on the frame the grab connects.
[/list]

[h2]Netplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Various stability tweaks to netcode and matchmaking across all platforms.
[*] Fixed improper disconnection of players, causing them to see timeout messages nonstop when they weren't connected to anyone.
[/list]

[h2]Arcade[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed mirror matches sometimes happening before the penultimate fight.
[*] Added additional text to the game over screen to display that you should press start.
[*] Fixed Adrik being able to attack after a dash in the ladder screen.
[*] Fixed incorrect font being used for the press any button text.
[/list]

[h2]Story[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an exploit that could allow you to choose a color that you have not unlocked yet.
[/list]

[h2]Localization[/h2]
[list]
[*] Numerous typos and text adjustments across all languages.
[/list]

[h2]Controls[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added default OK/Cancel buttons for player 2 at all times. So using the quick F1 button key to open the pause menu in Juice would not soft lock people who had never set the controls for player 2.
[*] Added additional tooltips and text on the macro buttons to help players understand their functionality and that they can be set to anything they want.
[/list]

[h2]Replays[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed 1 frame of flicker at the start of a replay or spectating match.
[*] Fixed Replay recording not stopping completely sometimes, causing unintended frame-rate drops.
[/list]

[h2]Accessibility[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a Super Flash Reduction option in the options for people who were having issues with the super flash effects.
[/list]

[h2]Achievements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Restored missing color for the Lab Zombie Achievement.
[*] Fixed rank-related achievements not being given at the correct ranks.
[/list]

[h2]Added 2 new colors for all characters![/h2]

[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] Exp panel will no longer count up from 0 every time.
[*] Moved the Crossplay button under the matchmaking tab, so it's easier for players to see.
[*] Fixed platform icons not always switching to their proper globe icon after joining a lobby with a crossplay host.
[*] Added version number in the options screen for sake of clarity.
[*] Added ping, jitter, and rift information on top of the screen in all netplay matches.
[*] Fixed text-bubble button not disappearing properly in multi-line dialogs.
[*] Fixed names on the bottom left not always updating when switching from a co-op to a matchmaking lobby.
[*] Replay and spectating dialogs will no longer close automatically after you watch a replay.
[/list]

[h2]Character Select[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash backing out of character select in a specific way.
[/list]

[h2]1v1/Teams[/h2]
[list]
[*] Made the winning team/player invincible after they land the last hit, so they cannot be killed by stray projectiles during the round transition.
[/list]

[h2]Stages[/h2]
[list]
[*] Optimizations to the Worx stage.
[*] Optimizations to the Guts stage.
[*] Optimizations to the Fairgrounds stage.
[*] Added Hidden Temple stage as part of Nyra's custom arcade mode home (Nyra's home is no longer the Guts).
[/list]

[h2]Fight HUD[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the badge level-up sound always playing at the start of an online game.
[*] Fixed the win banner being ever-so-slightly visible at the end of a round, even when it should have disappeared.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Blog - November 2024: Launch Features & 2025 Roadmap
notes.content:
[h1]Dev Blog - November 2024: Launch Features & 2025 Roadmap[/h1]

Can you feel it? We're merely DAYS away from Diesel Legacy's launch, where you'll be able to team up and brawl against the rest of the world using 10 playable characters. But that's just the beginning! We've got a metric ton of content on launch, and more to come on the way.

[h2]Table of Contents[/h2]
[list]
[*] Launch Features
[*] Official Tournament: Holiday Matsuri / CEOtaku 2024
[*] November Recap
[/list]

[h2]Launch Features[/h2]
Diesel Legacy launches as a COMPLETE GAME (shocker to anyone who has played video games in 2024) with a ton of bells and whistles.

Here's what you can expect on Day 1.

[list]
[*] 10 Playable Fighters
[*] Versus Mode
[*] Online Matchmaking
[*] Online Private Lobbies
[*] Training Mode
[*] Story Mode
[*] Arcade Mode
[*] Replays / Live Spectator
[*] Player Ranking
[*] Leaderboards
[*] Various Unlockables & Achievements
[/list]

[h3]10 Playable Fighters[/h3]
Rory, Ruby, Fritz, Rotwang, Eleanora, Nyra, Dieselmech, Damkina-- with newcomers Saga and Adrik will be playable on DAY ONE! Each character has their own unique archetype that can't be explained so easily. The best way to find out who fits best is to try them all!

Day 1 Patch Content:
[list]
[*] Rory: Powerhouse, Close-Range
[*] Ruby: Speedy, Manueverability
[*] Fritz: Debuffer, Trickster
[*] Rotwang: Flight, Burn
[*] Eleanora: Projectile-Range, Assists
[*] Nyra: Speedy, Grappler
[*] Dieselmech: Big Body, Long-Range
[*] Damkina: Stances, Mid-Range
[*] Saga: Powerhouse, Grappler
[*] Adrik: Deceptive, Trickster
[/list]

[h3]Versus Mode[/h3]
[i]Local and Online Multiplayer OK![/i]

Pick up your gauntlets and start swinging! Fill up the match with local or online friends, enemies, or CPUs. Best part is that you can play online even with multiple local players! This mode will allow you to choose stages and make match customizations.

[h3]Online Matchmaking[/h3]
[i]Local and Online Multiplayer OK![/i]

Match with ANYONE across the WORLD and play in either 2v2 or Free-For-All. Our RealMatch rollback will ensure you get the most premium gameplay experience no matter what! (As a fighting game fan, I need to say while the game handles Wi-Fi just fine, please use a hard connection if possible.)

[h3]Online Private Lobbies[/h3]
[i]Local and Online Multiplayer OK![/i]

Need to quickly join a buddy or running an online tournament? Our extremely simple lobby system makes it so anyone can pop in a short code and automatically join a customizable lobby.

In addition, lobbies will also work joining any other mode. Everything is possible!

[h3]Training Mode[/h3]
[i]Local and Online Multiplayer OK![/i]

The ultimate training mode! Complete with tons of match modifiers, frame data, frame data bars, save states, shortcuts and everything else you've ever wanted to lab a game-- you'll find it here.

[h3]Story Mode[/h3]
[i]Local and Online Multiplayer OK![/i]

Immerse yourself in Diesel Legacy's universe with our full fledged Story Mode. This mode comes complete with all 10 playable characters with their own unique story content, as everyone fights for the fate of the Iron City! This mode includes some unique challenges that you won't find anywhere else.

[h3]Arcade Mode[/h3]
[i]Local and Online Multiplayer OK![/i]

Instead of waiting, say 3 years, after launch-- we've got a staple to the fighting game experience on day one! Face match after match in a tower-style gauntlet to get the high score!

To reiterate, you can play Co-Op with a friend online or offline to chase the top ranks!

[h3]Replays / Live Spectator[/h3]
Any match you play, you can go back and watch with rewind and pause features. Best yet, you'll be able to do "Takeover Mode" which will allow you to play back everyone's inputs and take over a character to see what you could've done better.

You'll also be able to watch any current online match going on-- even if you're joining in late!

[h3]Player Ranking[/h3]
If you win a match and an internet ranking doesn't show a bar filling up, did you really win? Yes, but a little more incentive might help!

Player Rankings will increase per win, also increasing your ranking each time. Can you become the Master of Iron City? You'll have a lot of competition ahead of you. Kick, scratch, explode your way to the top.

[h3]Leaderboards[/h3]
Compare yourself and dominate your friends, and then, THE WORLD! Check your rankings with both ranking and arcade score.

[h3]Various Unlockables & Achievements[/h3]
Unlock different color schemes with each character by various means! For Achievement/Trophy Hunters, you'll have a blast exploring all the different modes.

notes.title: Saga: Grapple City - NEW CHARACTER
notes.content:
[h1]Saga: Grapple City[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/6d53247a281bb0873b8f35488e5dbb4f512aec30.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/28a0328130dbef5340237c45fe49d73fde5d1bc7.gif[/img]

[h2]Introduction to Saga[/h2]
Saga is piledriving the competition! 🎪

Saga's massive body ensures she will have optimal multi-opponent slam-dunking, hit-absorbing, meat-eating, cannonball-catching, raw wrestling power. In other words, she's an absolute unit that'll make any grappler fan get hyped.

Saga will be playable on the game's release on December 3rd, 2024!

[h2]Lore[/h2]
While a circus houses all kinds of talent, oddities, and “unique” individuals, you’d be hard pressed to find a specimen of sheer size and strength as mighty as Saga. Towering above just above anyone, Saga is known as “The Mountain of Might”, and “The Ice Giant” to the citizens that have seen her feats of strength.

Despite her incredible stature, Saga is a jovial soul who wishes for nothing more than the cheer of the young audience goers and for the prosperity of her fellow adoptive circus family. She’s lost everything before, and knows how precious each of those people are.

Whoever threatens that, will be in for a whole world of hurt.

Saga’s physicality is all anyone needs to see to know she’s formidable in a scuffle. Her massive frame and powerlifting strength are her most important assets in any fight, usually overpowering opponents with ease, often throwing them about like rag-dolls. She even sports huge arm weights around her wrists so she’s perpetually maintaining “the pump”. You certainly don’t want to be on the receiving end of those giant mittens! If she can bend steel rebar like a swizzle stick, imagine...

[h2]Gameplay Summary[/h2]
Saga has access to various command grabs-- ground to ground, ground to air, air to air, and even reaching across multiple lanes. She has an armored stance run, a jumping projectile (a massive weight, naturally), a sweep that pulls in opponents and a lot more than you'd normally expect from a grappler.

In true Diesel Legacy spirit, no inputs are too complicated. All moves can be executed with either a quarter-circle motion (except for one charge motion).

In this quick character breakdown, we're going to go over SOME of her more notable moves.

[h3]Normal: Stake Bite[/h3]
[i]cr. D[/i]

[previewyoutube=yysI6Gkx81Q;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Saga's cr. D works as a normal sweep EXCEPT for the fact that it essentially pulls in all players from more than half screen-- opponents AND teammates. Save your teammate from being combo'd or pull in opponents for a mixup. The best part? If the sweep connects, both you and your opponent recover on the same exact frame (0 on block), putting them in an even mixup.

[h3]Normal: Weight Toss[/h3]
[i]j. D[/i]

[previewyoutube=JmtbOcovjQM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Saga's j.D throws a massive weight at her opponent. Think of it like an air fireball, but instead of mystic spiritual energy, it's just dropping an anvil on someone, Looney Tunes style. Mix her j.D with a super jump, and you'll be able to do crossup projectile attacks!

[h3]Mechanics: Broad Tosser[/h3]
[i]AB[/i]

[previewyoutube=Cn58GVQkqDg;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Saga grabs her opponent and bowls them across the screen! If they hit a wall, they'll wall splat for a follow-up combo. They can also roll into their opponent and hit them!

[h3]Mechanics: Leg Day (Taunt)[/h3]
[i]A+D[/i]

[previewyoutube=ZCHOP0MSEzM;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Saga pulls out a delicious piece of meat and devours it in a way that would make Joey Chestnut jealous. Successfully devouring gives Saga a very useful buff for her throws, which she can stack up to three times.

The best part is that Saga's taunt is normal cancelable, which means she can safely eat canceling from her cr. D and other various moves.

[h3]Special: Chump Twister[/h3]
[i]QCF+AB[/i]

[previewyoutube=ZfWYg28Fvlo;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

The centerpiece of any good grappler, the grounded command throw. Boasting quick startup (5 frames), massive range and savage damage-- this is what all opponents fear.

If successful, Saga's command grab plants your opponent firmly in the ground, where you can follow-up with a small combo.

HOWEVER, if Saga had at least one piece of meat in her belly (indicated by the glow of her bangles), Saga spends a little more time spinning her opponent around, planting them deeper inside, giving you time to link a juggle combo afterward.

[h3]Special: Bally[/h3]
[i]Hold Back, Forward + D[/i]

[previewyoutube=-a8BUBI_ONw;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Ready, Steady, Go. Saga charges all her inner might and lashes forward, giving her access to all her grounded normals WITH armor that will absorb everything but the strongest attacks.

The best part is if she cancels out of her armored run with any normal attack, it carries the armor traits throughout that move!

Saga's armored move acts similar to Dieselmech's passive armor-- standing A/B/C attacks require more hits to break it, where standing D automatically breaks it. Jumping A/B attacks require more hits to break it, but jumping C/D will automatically break it.

[h3]Meltdown: Key to the Midway[/h3]
[i]QCF+AC[/i]

[previewyoutube=U3FDm1DawNo;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Saga grabs not one, but TWO (or maybe more?!) opponents and takes them for a ride, planting them firmly in the ground afterwards. Not only can she multi-grab opponents, but she can grab a lane above and below her. Opponents can't escape post-flash, so if they are in range, their fate is sealed.

Even more, the more meat stocks Saga has, the longer the automatic follow-up the move will be. Max out at three stocks, and you'll see what happens.

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]
We've got a TON more coming, but we'll be revealing piece by piece AND you'll be able to get your hands on her (or her hands on everyone) by December 3rd!

We've still got another character to reveal in the future, see if you can find our hint below. 👁️🪄

notes.title: Damkina: Eternal Beauty - NEW CHARACTER
notes.content:
[h1]Damkina: Eternal Beauty[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/ab439ec62af3fd68a0ded808927f42a6050669a5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/ff41e813e23804c6786d86bf83014bc8cc41ad26.gif[/img]

[h2]Intro[/h2]
Damkina is stepping onto the scene! 🍸

Damkina's glamourous diva moveset will pummel, slap and stomp anyone who dares oppose her. Beware though! She holds a nefarious, dark secret.

Damkina will be playable at the Diesel Legacy booth at [b]EVO 2024[/b] in Las Vegas from July 19th to 21st!

[h2]Lore[/h2]
The town’s biggest cultural phenomenon is the cinema, and its shining star is none other than Damkina, the Goddess of the Silver Screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/d52458c4b0478790aab383ceed8b2ffd785594cd.gif[/img]

She is the best, the brightest, the one everyone wishes they were or wishes they were with, and she knows it. If she wants something, she’ll simply take it, and she’ll step all over anyone in her way-- all while looking smashing.

She was discovered and brought to New Libertis by FALCORP’s head, Hieronymous Frazer. He saw an opportunity to use her to promote their products and the latest fashions in the movies, but she harbors a nefarious secret.

Damkina is of mysterious origins in the old world, but the tabloids and conspiracy junkies suggest she’s much older than she appears to be. Could it be true? Any real details are obscured -- and she has the power to make it stay that way. One thing is certain. She never makes an appearance without her shiny green gemstone dangling from the neck.

This magical jewel, known by some archeologists as the fabled Eye of Sēth, was thought to be pure myth. Many believe it’s powers to be only mere movie magic. She’ll use this stone to defend herself when the sheer weight of her personality won’t suffice.

Wild cat scratches and impaling high heels are viscous enough for any opponent, but her otherworldly abilities are quite dangerous as well, as she’s able to use telekinesis at will and project her slithering aura to attack. It’ll be a bad day for anyone unlucky enough to get on this dame’s bad side (which is almost a certainty, really).

[h2]Gameplay Summary[/h2]
Damkina has access to a stance, command grab, decently ranged normals and much more. As a stance character, she's able to flow between her normal attacks to her carpet stance-- giving her access to another moveset. She also has access to a life stealing gem which gives her the ability to sustain herself on the battlefield longer than her enemies.

In addition, Damkina has NO motion inputs except for her supers-- making her ideal for executing specials quickly OR picking up a first time character as a fighting game newcomer.

In this quick character breakdown, we're going to go over SOME of her more notable moves.

[h3]Normal: Apply Makeup[/h3]
[i]st. B[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/3a28d5e27f870bdc4c0ce367194bb73aef13133f.gif[/img]
[i]It's never a bad time to put on your face.[/i]

Damkina's standing B might seem like a normal attack, but holding it down allows her to [i]glamourize[/i]. Tapping left or right applies makeup, and letting go finishes the attack. Remember this mechanic, as it will be very useful in tandem with one of her unrevealed abilities.

[h3]Special: Gem Command Throw[/h3]
[i]B+C[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/df2e2838c64cb1d76185d3e29035ec6657f2b238.gif[/img]
[i]Some use it to eat pizza, others use it to extend their combos.[/i]

By tapping both B and C, Damkina uses her mysterious gem to do a ranged command grab that goes a quarter of the screen. If successful, she uses the power of telekinesis to slam her opponent on the ground, giving her a ground bounce to continue her combo.

This command grab also works to continue combos both on the ground AND in the air, allowing for some pretty nasty combo extensions.

This move comes out so slow that she can cancel almost any normals into this move, constantly keeping opponents on their toes. Watch out though, if they jump the grab, Damkina is in a very punishable state.

[h3]Special: Carpet Stance[/h3]
[i]B+D[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/2256a3b0134bd2c1bad03e147c145296e033338b.gif[/img]
[i]Aladdin wishes he had a (non-alcoholic) martini on his magic carpet ride.[/i]

The staple, bread 'n butter and absolute chain that turns Damkina from a cool character into an absolute superstar-- her carpet stance. By simply tapping B+D on the ground, in the air, while doing a normal on hit or block-- she cancels whatever she's doing and is able to start flying around, complete with her not suspicious elixir in hand.

Mobility-wise, she'll be able to use the air version of this to bait anti-airs and manuever away from danger in the air. While she can't airdash, if she uses this on the ground, she'll have access to another ground dash. At any point if she's on the carpet, she can use any jump to immediately get a second jump to trick opponents.

Of course, her entire moveset changes while in carpet stance.

[b]A:[/b] Quick Attack
[b]B:[/b] Large vertical hitbox, causes backturn state on hit.
[b]C:[/b] Large vertical hitbox, launches on hit.
[b]D:[/b] Large horizontal hitbox, exits carpet stance upon use.
[b]A+B:[/b] Petrifying Stare -- A slow command throw, but can be used on ground and air. Grounded version can only grab grounded opponents. Air version can grab both grounded and air opponents. If grab is successful, opponent turns into stone for a follow-up combo.
[b]B+D:[/b] Cancel - Pressing B+D again while in carpet stance allows her to nearly immediately go back into her normal stance, let it be on the ground or in the air. This stance may be key to unlocking her true combo potential.

Mastery of Carpet Stance is the fastest way to mastery of Damkina, so be sure to experiment with what she's capable of.

[h3]Meltdown: Sadistic Stomp[/h3]
[i]QCF+BD[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/19c168ec0da7574f70b434ce35c89d9dc0375c12.gif[/img]
[i]Some people pay for this sort of thing.[/i]

Damkina's temper flips from 0 to 100!

By doing QCF+BD, Damkina rages up and stomps down on anyone unfortunate enough to be across her path. She can change lanes and distances by holding the appropriate direction (up, down, forward), making her a threat in any lane. Her stomps also OTG, making easy combos off of her sweep or jumping D knockdown.

If it successfully connects, she stomps and grinds her heels on her opponent until she kicks them for a guaranteed wall splat, allowing apt teams to follow up with a combo of their choice. This Meltdown can easily change the tides of a battle, immediately cornering opponents upon hit and allowing for a massive damage and mixup opportunity if you've got a solid gameplan.

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]
There's a ton more coming: Including other specials, an install meltdown and more. For now, you'll have to wait, but not for long!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/0afc8daf8a40ba899987af68ad5186ac4b30b642.gif[/img]

Damkina will be playable at the Diesel Legacy booth at [b]EVO 2024[/b] in Las Vegas from July 19th to 21st! You'll also be able to watch a short preview of her at the [b]Hawaii Suite[/b], with a stream by our friends at [url=https://twitch.tv/leveluplive]LevelUpLive[/url] on July 18th at 10:00PM PT.

Citizens,

We've got a LOT to announce, but first-- Thank you all for taking our survey! We've had a lot of responses, and the team has been responding by going to town making more quality-of-life changes, balance adjustments, bug fixes and more!

In this update, we'll be quickly going over:
[list]
[*]Top 4 Survey Takeaways
[*]CEO 2024 Tournament Results
[*]EVO 2024 Announcement
[/list]

[h1]Top 4 Survey Takeaways[/h1]
[h3]1) Needs Higher-Level Tutorialization[/h3]
1a) We had quite a bit of feedback about the lack of higher-level tutorialization (specific character guides, combo structure, etc). For the full release of the game, we are intending on having tutorials, combo trials and much more as a part of the base product!

In addition, We are currently creating and releasing thorough beginner-to-intermediate tutorials which are being released via our socials (follow them!), which are definitely worth a watch while waiting for the next playable.

[h3]2) Fixing Various Minor Bugs/Quality of Life Options[/h3]
2a) Users have reported a variety of minor-game impacting bugs (alongside some rare major ones)-- thank you for letting us know! We're working on fixing everything reported, and more. Some examples include the ranking system's flow, disconnections and slowdowns caused by supers.

We are also including much more quality of life options in the future, including graphics options, more intuitive UI flow for the Juice Bar and Traditional Menus, and better button/macro mapping. Let us know if there's anything else that would help you or others access the game easier!

[h3]3) Overall Balance[/h3]
3a) Users have noted frustration dealing with certain moves. While we want to keep the game in a competitive state for longtime play, we also want to ensure the game is accessible so newcomers don't get steamrolled by single-dimension (read: degenerate) gameplay. We already showed a bit of this with changes to Ruby prior to the demo launch and a post-launch patch addressing Dieselmech's armor.

We have a LOT more coming to further tune characters, but we ultimately will do a major balance pass once all of the base characters have been fully fleshed out. For now, we're experimenting with what we think would be the most fun for everyone.

[h3]4) More Characters[/h3]
4a) There was a wide call on our feedback form to have more characters-- and as you could have probably told with the empty character select screen, we have a few more on the way! notes.title: Here Comes A New Challenger: Dieselmech
notes.content:
[h1]Dieselmech: Steel Body - Golden Heart[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/fd466c183d0203df8cca932f94cea150aec22aee.png[/img]

We're excited to show off our latest character: [b]Dieselmech![/b]

Dieselmech a three-ton absolute unit filled to the brim with extreme firepower that can leave your opponent in smoldering ashes. Landmines, heat-seeking missiles, thrusters, exploding payloads, machine guns and the ultimate organic lifeform death machine (otherwise known as a cat).

Did we mention Dieselmech has a cat buddy named Servo? He'll come to support Dieselmech and even help you with your combos.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/3c7ae8995ca881abb9ba06f2fb84c57bffea64d0.gif[/img]

Dieselmech is voiced by [url=https://twitter.com/Omahdon]Edwyn Tiong[/url], from various other indie games such as Freedom Planet 2, Tangle Tower and Old Skies.

Servo the cat is all voiced by these lil' dudes: Milkshake, Squirrel, Canyon & Olive
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/0960d41c76f9b4236a9e56977e89cbcf8365989a.png[/img]

[h2]Lore[/h2]
[i]When Professor Darling began work on the gargantuan auto-soldier that would later become known as the latest and greatest Dieselmech line of FALCORP weaponry, he had meant for it to be a friend to man and defender of the nation: an unwavering protector, a symbol of progress peace for the future.

That changed when the professor was kidnapped by FALCORP and forced to repurpose his design for less noble purposes. Now outfitted with flame throwers, bombs, and many inhumane forms of attack, the mass produced machines are often field tested in the slums, culling the poor, and voiceless inhabitants of the city.

Dieselmech is a naive autonomous machine, but still a powerful force to be reckoned with in any battle. With his sheer mass and powerful gadgetry, Dieselmech will do everything in his power to protect his new friend… and can come to the aid of those in need.

One particular metal soldier retains a spark of the professor's original ideals, brought forth by a lonely stray kitten.[/i]

[h2]Character Mechanics[/h2]
This hunk of metal's got a ton of new mechanics to this series, including passive super/hyper armor, a heat mechanic and certain enhanced and "revved" normals.

[h3]Super Armor (No-Sell)[/h3]
Dieselmech has passive super armor (shoutouts to big body characters), which allows him to automatically take certain hits without getting stunned out of his move.

He regenerates to full armor very quickly, but does not have any armor when he's jumping. In additional, all "D" moves, meltdowns and certain other powerful moves will automatically bypass armor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/8203682c357b81dc2908ac083a8b5ad72d8f2cc0.gif[/img]
[i]Legal courts trying to serve you? Try this![/i]

[h3]Overheat | Hyper Armor (Engine of War / Boiling Over)[/h3]

After doing certain moves outlined below, Dieselmech will gain "heat." Gain enough heat and you'll be in an overheated state for a short amount of time. You cannot reduce your heat level until you hit the overheated state, which at that point will start to defuse until you reach your normal state again.

While overheating has certain negative effects, it also grants the iron giant something called "hyper armor." This makes it so nearly all projectiles and strikes prevent being stunned (outside of a combo), even while airborne.

This hyper armor state does make him vulnerable to taking damage, especially since he cannot block while piping hot. He is also still vulnerable to all throws.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/eeb6339151d6cc025fb83d2565c8a52bbcbeb9ce.gif[/img]
[i]BREAKING NEWS: Local robot too angry to die.[/i]

[h3]Float (Hedge Hop)[/h3]
[i]Input: Hold up while jumping[/i]

Allows Dieselmech to use his jet boots to float in the air, with the ability to propel sideways. You'll be able to cancel and float again, but each time Hedge Hop activates, it uses a little more heat.

He'll be able to use jumping A and C attacks without falling, so you can use this to control air neutral while not fully committing to a jump arc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/3f1b160a1f092b155bfc47d345e1792bb59919bc.gif[/img]
[i]Did we mention he drops mines?[/i]

[h3]Enhanced & Revved Normals[/h3]
Dieselmech has a significant amount of range from his normals-- including jumping B, crouching B, standing C and standing D.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/6ede681469a9e39fed1b4457e04817e1cd931dd4.gif[/img]

In addition to that, he can enhance his moves in one of two ways.

[h3]B or C moves (Frostbite, Juicer, Hotcake):[/h3]
Holding down the button enhances it at the cost of heat. He cannot perform these attacks if he is overheated. These can be used for additional properties, including more damage, hitstun and chip.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/8e811834ccc2fb4fce6018b7a0edd49d54d396dd.gif[/img]

[h3]D moves (Toot Sweet): [/h3]
Dieselmech can "rev" the move by pressing buttons immediately after. One extra button revs it to level 2, and two extra buttons revs it to level 3. All of which cost different levels of heat. He cannot perform revved moves while overheated.

For example, to do a normal sweep-- just hit the crouching D button.
Level 2 Sweep: Crouching D, then A/B/C/D. (ie: cr. D, C)
Level 3 Sweep: Crouching D, then A/B/C/D then another A/B/C/D. (ie: cr. D, D, B)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/f7f1fd144a39d6b9c926215b63402b19bbde4773.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/1d2de398a1b2a557628f87529a8552d0aafe30a5.gif[/img]

[h3]Throw[/h3]
Dieselmech's throw works a little different than most standard throws. When a grab is successful, he sucks the victim into his belly-- where they must face [cat] in a 10-0 matchup for a short amount of time.

During this time, Dieselmech can shoot him out of his cannon or do his jumping D to slam them onto the ground. If Dieselmech gets stunned by any attack or throw that breaks through his armor, he'll immediately drop his opponent. In addition, swallowed opponents can mash buttons to get out quicker. Be fast!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/e538bab7b313783b2aea3424dc0b813c9d70e3ca.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/f1d02bdabccc281c5a2493a05c0fc01f1c96fde3.gif[/img]
[i]3 seconds [/i]

[h2]Special Moves[/h2]

[h3]Napoo[/h3]
[i]Input: QCF+D (D, D, D, D, D)[/i]

These missiles, that have been hidden in Dieselmech's arsenel, will track all opponents in any lane. Keep tapping to send out more missles. This is a great way to lock down opponents, allowing you and your teammate to close the distance with a mix.

Watch out though, this move adds a ton of heat-- doing full missiles twice guarantees you'll be in overheat state where he will be locked out of the move until he's back to normal heat.

In addition, while these missiles will track from corner to corner, there is a bit of a blindspot right in front of Dieselmech, allowing savvy opponents to slip in and get a free hit on him unscathed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/457ea8ae82728cb5f0122760c3756e6064347e32.gif[/img]
[i]It's fun to yell, "you have no hope," when you launch these[/i]

[h3]Gravel Crusher[/h3]
[i]Input: BD (Rev OK)[/i]

A nasty and huge overhead that can also hit opponents while they are knocked down.

This move can be revved up, each one adding significantly more heat.

[list]
[*] Level 1 version is very slow and allows the opponent to tech out easily.
[*] Level 2 version is faster, and causes a hard knockdown.
[*] Level 3 version is extremely fast, and causes a ground bounce for juggles.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/9f4966a2f6e854b2984bc67b854c7cb77b47fa20.gif[/img]
[i]Back in my day, this is how we made sure our kids got lifelong trauma[/i]

[h3]Iron Rations (Minnie | Archie)[/h3]
[i]Load Input: QCF+A/C
Shoot Forward: QCF+A (Air OK)
Shoot Angled: QCF+C (Air OK)[/i]

Loads a massively explosive payload. Once loaded, fires the payload-- which self-detonates over a certain distance.

Keep in mind, you don't need a payload when you have an opponent in your belly. They ARE the payload.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/c6f23a7356ae209e6cefd300eab68b8a080fe429.gif[/img]
[i]Talking a lot of smack for someone within QCF+A range[/i]

[h2]Meltdown Supers[/h2]

[h3]Big Bertha[/h3]
[i]Load Input: QCF+AC
Shoot Forward: QCF+A (Air OK)
Shoot Angled: QCF+C (Air OK)[/i]

Loads a mega-powerful payload. Once loaded, the normal fire input will shoot-- but this time it's super powered with lots of tasty shrapnel. That gives that spicy meatball the zing it needs for significant damage AND a wallsplat that can be comboed after.

If an opponent is currently being thrown and you had a Big Bertha payload already in there, firing the opponent will use that payload.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/ddae73bea1e6136ff7d1b7ed944d41d9d1afd769.gif[/img]
[i]Falcorp's new Air Express Shipping option[/i]

[h3]World War Wonderful[/h3]
[i]Input: QCF+BD[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/96cc85689aa030dceac468fb7878d79effec4c8f.gif[/img]

Automatically transforms Dieselmech into a tank, giving him 8-way movement and his weapons in a more accessible format.

Pressing [b]BD[/b] transforms him back. Getting knocked down causes him to revert as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/aa28a1bb92104ee0a8564e7fe6376e84dd4039d6.gif[/img]

[h3]Machine Gun[/h3]
[i]Input: Tap A[/i]
[list]
[*] Tapping A shoots low-impact bullets
[*] This damages opponents, but does not cause hitstun
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/1c6f5b4092a9048876273ca6ed7218e42c9cfdc0.gif[/img]

[h3]Iron Ration / Big Bertha[/h3]
[i]Input: Hold A[/i]
[list]
[*] Holding A shoots more impactful shots, but gains heat.
[*] First level shoots an Iron Ration, causing moderate damage and a knockback
[*] Second level shoots a Big Bertha, causing massive damage and causes a wall splat
[*] If charging a move while transforming back to normal form, Dieselmech keeps the shell loaded
[*] Cannot charge to second level while overheated
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/2884617746bf7d9f063ddd3c661ad720ad169d40.gif[/img]

[h3]Jump[/h3]
[i]Input: B[/i]
[list]
[*] In a cruel world where people want to be cheap and throw you, this is your only escape
[*] Disabled while overheated
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/20d5a9d0951867082ec220a02ffdfdabde761f0d.gif[/img]

[h3]Hotcake[/h3]

[list]

[*] If overheated, only drops small mine
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/dfb91df3fcbb076ffc5a73d669b9b309f33de929.gif[/img]

[h3]Napoo[/h3]

notes.title: The Iron City’s Future: Playtest 2 Summary
notes.content:
Thank you for helping us stress test Diesel Legacy in our latest playtest! We’ve been listening to everyone, and are proud to announce some upcoming additions and changes in the future.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1959140/Diesel_Legacy_The_Brazen_Age/

There’s a ton of fancy stuff in the works, but here are some that you can look forward to:
[list]
[*] Redesigned Lobby System
[*] Redone Interactive Menu System
[*] New “Traditional” Menu System
[*] Gameplay Balance[/list]
For additional characters and stages, keep an eye out on our upcoming devblogs and socials to be the first to find out what we’ve got planned.

[h2]Lobby Behavior[/h2]
Lobbies will be going through a complete redesign, ensuring that you can always find a match whenever you want.

Many users have reported the inconsistency in being able to instantly find a match. The reality of the matter is that while there were matches going on, you wouldn’t be able to queue up unless an additional 3 players filled up another match.

With our upcoming updates, players can expect to be able to see a list of open lobbies and potentially join a queue while spectating another match (if the host allows queuing). players will also be able to substitute players for CPUs to be able to start a match early.

Another upcoming feature is that players will also be able to play nearly every mode in the game, while simultaneously searching for an online match. Once the match is over, you’ll seamlessly transfer back to the previous mode you were in.

When a mode is currently looking for players to fill, a pop-up for that mode will show, indicating that matches should be immediately joinable.

In addition, a quick match option will be available– finding the first available match within the various game modes.

For example, players can play in story mode, pause the game and set to search for a casual match, then go back to playing. Once the game finds a match, it’ll pause the game if you want to accept the match. If you accept the match, you’ll play in it until you’re done, and the game will drop you off right at the point you left story mode.

[h2]Menu System[/h2]
We’ve received a lot of great feedback regarding our interactive menu system:
New players had issues finding and understanding the features of the game.
There was a general request for a traditional menu system.

During the playtest, we released a new update that took the main gameplay out of the basement and put it right in front of where the player spawns.

In future updates, we will continue to organize options into more accessible formats. We will also include miniature descriptions of every menu option to help players understand what each option is capable of.

For example, we are considering consolidating all online options into a singular “online” choice that will spawn off into all the modes. Upon highlighting this option, a description will show that this choice includes Matchmaking, Lobby Meet-Up and more.

For those looking for different menu options, Diesel Legacy will include both the interactive Juice Bar and a traditional pick-and-choose menu, choosable at the title screen. This traditional menu option will allow players to immediately pick their desired modes.

More on the original interactive menu system, we are planning on doing more for a social experience, but more will come soon.

[h2]Disconnections[/h2]
A few consistent cases of disconnecting were found during the playtest. The cause of these were either from desyncing or players intentionally quitting, causing the entire game to come to a halt.

While there was a playtest update that allowed the game to continue, there will be additional fixes for disconnects to ensure players will have a 1:1 experience from offline to online.

[h2]Gameplay Balance/Features[/h2]
While the game was out for only a limited amount of time, we will be making slight changes to moves that are currently underutilized and slight changes to moves that lock down opponents in the prototype 2v2 three-lane landscape of the game.

We have been listening to feedback, and want to make sure characters will be able to shine even further in their own unique archetypes. Future content pieces may hint to what some of these changes will be.

[h2]Looking Ahead[/h2]
The future of the Iron City is bright! We’re working with online FGC scenes to build the game that YOU want to play, however you want to play it. Casual, competitive– no matter who you are, we want you to love the game.

Our team will be providing occasional updates via a devblog that will highlight more of what you can look forward to.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Major Quality of Life Updates
notes.content:
Your taxpayer dollars are going to work in the Iron City!

We've updated Diesel Legacy with a major patch addressing UI/UX changes, continuing gameplay after disconnections, a vast amount of additional gameplay mechanics for ghosts and gameplay tweaks.

See below for more details!

[h3]Update notes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Redistributed the icons in Juice to place the online icons near the start; no more basement.
[*] Single-person disconnects now don't end the game, or the meetup; instead, the character is KO'd, but the game continues.
[*] Facing direction lock no longer counts players in different lanes as "close" to you; your character will remain facing the same opponent until another opponent enters your lane, or you enter their lane. 
[*] Ghost Buster (burst) and Ghost Guard (parry) are now possible immediately after being KO'd, rather than having to wait for yourself to hit the ground.
[*] Ghost Buster no longer unalives your ghost forever, instead it reduces the maximum ghost HP to 50% and has the same recharge period as running out of HP in any other way; however, you still can only use it once. 
[*] There are now 3 types of Ghost Buster depending on how much health the ghost has: 80-100% starts up in 6 frames, wall sticks, and is plus on block; 40-79% starts up in 12 frames and is slightly negative on block; and 1-39% starts up in 18 frames and is pretty easily punishable on block. All of them scale damage to minimum and place the opponent near the end of any juggle limits.
[*] You can now Ghost Buster when your teammate is in blockstun, but it cannot produce the fastest version of the move, only the second-fastest.
[*] Ghosts heal more slowly when their teammate is in hitstun or blockstun.
[*] Ghost Vengeance (assist special attacks) are possible sooner after parrying, and Ghost Buster is always possible if the other person is hit, even while a parry ghost is out.
[*] Fixed various bugs related to dashing: you can now jump out of your dash after a superflash, e.g. vs Rotwang's Teppichband (command grab Meltdown super); removed the ability to convert a straight dash to a lane-change dash by pressing the direction after the dash has already begun, so that crouching attacks can be done more easily by immediately pressing Down and attacking directly after dashing.
[*] Redid the button config screen, should make much more sense now.
[*] For clarity, the button tooltip at the bottom the screen now alternates between displaying keyboard, gamepad, and in-game button icons.
[/list]

notes.title: Nyra Character Introduction
notes.content:
[h1]NYRA: HER INNER PEACE BELIES OUTER FEROCITY[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/35e09e95e90f86f3a437e13547c05ff3c63e8925.gif[/img]

[b]CHARACTER ARCHETYPE[/b] - Hybrid Chain Grappler / Long Reach
[b]QUICK BIO[/b] - A skillful and agile practitioner of an ancient grappling art, Nyra is also the wielder of a peculiar set of extra limbs that bonded to her from her home village’s shrine.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1959140/Diesel_Legacy_The_Brazen_Age/

[h2]IN-DEPTH BIO[/h2]

Alagaratnam Nyra comes from a small village in the remote island of Sattva Bhūmi. This jungle island, who’s name means “Land of purity”, is a mythic natural wonder, relatively unspoiled by industry.

Wise beyond her years, Nyra is schooled in the spiritual as well as the sacred fighting arts of her people (an ancient form of grappling). For Nyra, each battle holds a lesson to be learned, which brings her closer to enlightenment.

Nyra’s village held an ancient idol statue, said to be a guardian deity for the inhabitants of the island. After disaster strikes the island from outside invaders, seeking to strip the island of its lush resources, Nyra’s people are forced to flee. Miraculously, their sacred statue awoke amidst the chaos and chose to bonded with Nyra, bestowing the otherworldly extra limbs known as the “iron lotus”, further enhancing her already formidable fighting skills.

Newly arrived in New Libertis, the bustling metropolis of the New World, Nyra has quickly made a name for herself in underground fight clubs as a fighting spectacle, but her true motives are to learn more about the shadowy hands that caused the destruction of her homeland. FALCORP Industries is likely the culprit, in their quest to usurp and exploit powerful energy sources for their products, weapons, and machines.

[h2]BASIC STRATEGY[/h2]

Nyra is an agile grappler with a number of tricks up her sleev-- err, extra arms. Quick and nimble up close, she has a number of long ranged normals, such as her jumping D, standing D and crouching D.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/e3dfebeb9f28ae74a5eaa140811aca32101e3ae8.gif[/img]

Nyra's extra limbs (her Iron Lotus) act as resources, giving Nyra access to mid-screen range throws, follow-up chain grabs, extended strike combos, strings and much more. Once these limbs are used, they'll burn out. If they all burn out, you won’t have access to her extra moves. However, each arm will naturally restore after a set amount of time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/1ce1863565f710db291bed8040f4bccf8c7c480a.gif[/img]

[h3]GRABHA - CHAIN COMMAND GRAB[/h3]

Nyra's signature move is Grabha [Quarter Circle Forward, A+B], a command grab. It might seem simple, but it is anything but that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/2700bb00eef0fa3ab3206dcf1f1752d3082869d3.gif[/img]

If it whiffs, she can quickly use her extra arms to attempt Lamba Grabha twice. Lamba Grabha reaches further and further with the additional benefit of reaching into other lanes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/ef31b914f177543d8d886112ff7e6f5c5087788a.gif[/img]

Upon scooping up your opponent, Nyra can choose from several different follow-up sequences depending on how many arms are available– including a devastating elbow drop, a wall-bounce combo extension, a fake out and much more.

At the cost of an arm resource, she can chain into Prithvi Mata [Down w/ any button], elbow dropping into her opponent putting them in an untechable knockdown state. Throw loops? She's got them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/dbb0777e3a82da6894cfdce0cf1afdc85d2df279.gif[/img]

Trying to extend your damage? Trade in an arm resource with Golden Catapult [Forward w/ any button], and she'll throw her opponent forward-- causing a wall-bounce, giving your team the chance to extend your combo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/cec34e0fa5e0a1ae21c481f4abb147c5c186d466.gif[/img]

There’s a ton more follow-up possibilities! We implore you to experiment with Nyra and find out what mix-ups you’ll have within arms’ reach.

[h3]RANGASRAMA KAAM OORJA - GUARD CANCEL[/h3]

Nyra also has the ability to use her extra limb resources for defensive purposes. If Nyra is currently blocking (on the ground OR in the air), she can cancel out of her block animation to go straight for an explosive Rangasrama Kaam Oorja (note the first letter of each word), turning the tables on overcommitting opponents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/36c604188c1bd74d2ca410d2e4bf140b721766ee.gif[/img]

[h3]SURYA BHEDANA - INSTALL MELTDOWN[/h3]

Nyra has a THREE meltdown supers in her arsenal–  all named after Yogic breath names. For this demonstration, we'll show off her Surya Bhedana [Quarter Circle Forward, A+C].

This move gives Nyra the ultimate ability to constantly launch a barrage of punches, activating every time a button is pressed for a limited amount of time. This gives you the ability to string together combos and juggles in almost any way. Experiment with this meltdown and see what you can do!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/6e9348caebbe76b9cf1605f88c4924dcd3323b1f.gif[/img]

[h2]Playtest 2 is soon![/h2]
Remember! Nyra, Eleanora, and the original four will be fully playable during the 2nd playtest, taking place on December 13th @ 10:00 AM PT until January 3rd @ 11:59PM PT! Get ready for the ultimate smackdown.

notes.title: Eleanora Character Introduction
notes.content:
[h1]ELEANORA: THE GUN-TOTING GANGSTER DRESSED TO KILL[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/a4f15af23e3dc235498e3432f537f3d6ffab061e.gif[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1959140/Diesel_Legacy_The_Brazen_Age/

[h2]Bio[/h2]

Eleanora has big dreams. She’s going to be living the high-life one day, people waiting on her hand and foot and everyone is going to know her name. And she’s going to be respected. But it’s going to take a lot of work as her adoptive family, the LaPointe Mafia, don’t give her any recognition.

Eleanora Maria Buccio was a street rat for most of her life, she turned to crime at a very young age after dropping out of grade school. Her only real family were two thick-headed, yet loyal, mates Brick and Weasel. Eleanora is the smartest of LaPointe’s goons by far. She is obsessive about upholding her style at all times and has a general “devil may care” attitude.

Educated by the streets, she’s quick to anger, never turns down a challenge, and a showboat to boot.
El is a dirty fighter, and has no qualms about using any or all objects around her (or hidden in her colossally cavernous trouser pocket) to get the upper hand. Just don’t scuff her outfit (a sure death sentence).

[h2]Basic Strategy[/h2]

Eleanora comes packed with everything she needs to light up her opponents with a variety of stylish moves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/7cc75bece70c4a6ef15dfaecfa9dc6f956dbdf75.gif[/img]

One of El's staple zoning tools is her C button. By tapping C while standing, she can throw up to three darts in succession. She also has access to both a jumping air-to-ground dart and a crouching ground-to-air-to-ground dart.

Eleanora also has access to a Chicago Typewriter (QCF+C). Holding the input for her machine gun allows her to empty her entire clip, but don’t be careless! It will leave you vulnerable after shooting, if done too close or if your bullets whiff.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/da5aa2384753fb29d14e3456594b572b2f6f97b7.gif[/img]

Feeling explosive? Eleanora’s Dyn-o-mite! (QCF+B) pulls out a bundle of dynamite that will detonate over time. She can pull it out both on the ground and in the air, and can manipulate it by holding the button or pressing forward or back to change the throw distance. If she’s hit out of holding it, she’ll drop it by her feet.

This dynamite, modeled after real life explosives, has the capability to hurt everyone– opponents, teammates and even yourself. Mastering Dyn-o-mite!'s timing is vital for making your enemies think twice about recklessly approaching.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/7b437c95bf431354752a4e7e0cf48d28a348fa7a.gif[/img]

What good is a gangster without her right (and left) hand man?

Pressing B+D will summon Weasel to drop kick in a lane above Eleanora’s position, while pressing down B+D will summon Brick, who will perform a running command grab in a lane below Eleanora’s position. Use this to cover lanes to keep the pressure off!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/e01b23bd9b751448ec8f854c6853087583418c12.gif[/img]

Using Loose End (QCF+D), Brick can bring in Patsy Doormat, a man who unwisely ignored some free advice. Patsy will absorb any attack that touches him, preventing nearby characters from taking damage. After enough damage, he breaks free and attempts to escape. (Don’t worry, it’s nothing a good night’s sleep won’t cure.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/09964a3285a214d4e8335782619a019b310e79f5.gif[/img]

As the final teaser, Eleanora has THREE Meltdown attacks– including Next of Kin (QCF B+D). This summons an associate to take care of business, preserving Eleanora’s alibi. It can be used to pick up downed opponents, and also used in a variety of situations on both defense and continued offense.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/337626b270448e34637e7f0bd9536c1613b2fbd9.gif[/img]

[h2]Playtest 2 is soon![/h2]
Remember, Eleanora will be fully playable during the 2nd playtest, taking place on December 13th @ 10:00 AM PT until January 3rd @ 11:59PM PT! This will be your chance to play her and give us any live feedback!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35450737/af7f14d94519132d21681ccc632715ab91b318c5.jpg[/img]

Welcome to the Juice Room, the central hub for all the different modes available in the beta. Simply walk your character to the different rooms and use any attack button to enter!

[list]
[*] TRAINING - Practice controlling your character, view your character’s command list, and master your combos at your own pace.
[*] VERSUS - Fight against bots, local opponents, or both!
[*] ONLINE - Matchmaking. Join a queue where you can practice until 3 other players connect.
[*] REPLAYS - Watch back recent matches you played… and even take control of the replay mid-playback to learn from your mistakes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/2458bdf754ee9fe72a276f6c634d89a9eb79536c.png[/img]

[h3]RUBY[/h3]
A super energetic delivery girl who uses her rocketskates to zoom around the city. Dashing builds up her momentum, which levels up her special moves. Once you get full momentum, get in there and mix up your opponent in order to deliver the pain.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/cdf320ac4e270016abdff24421f2dbad4a4421c8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/f4a857e256ba36a6529132fcd491d68583bd8c10.png[/img]

[h3]FRITZ[/h3]
An assassin working for the shadowy organization known only as the Wynant Society. Stock up to four different kinds of poisons, each with its own unique effects, and harass your opponents from out of their range or get in close and get to stabbing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44237949/240df8d33c3339712b1e517ed8e469ef344573e6.png[/img]

[h3]ROTWANG[/h3]
Scientist and muscle for the head of the Mega Corporation Falcorp the pragmatic Heironymous Frazer. Using a custom flamethrower that doubles as a jet pack, you can stay away and harass your opponents with huge jets and whirlwinds of fire, or get in close and use your flight to mix them up.
